verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian full-service law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product or platform that ingests user data. A user-facing control to opt out of AI model training is a category error for this kind of offering. Its AI and data-privacy advisory practice is a different capability and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
